organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Workspace name, timezone and default currency. The currency is only the display default — each amount is stored in its own currency with its USD value at the event date.
organization.name: Organization name

errors.name: Name must be at least 2 characters

security.title: Security
security.description: Session timeout, IP allowlist and your organization's 2FA policy.
security.require2faHint: Every member must set up 2FA on their next sign-in — set up your own under "Your two-factor authentication" below.
security.allowlistPlaceholder:
One IP or CIDR per line, e.g.
203.0.113.4
198.51.100.0/24
security.allowlistHint: An empty list means no restriction. Applies to sign-in only — an existing session stays valid from any IP.

totp.title: Your two-factor authentication
totp.description: Asked at sign-in in addition to your password: a code from an authenticator app, by email or by SMS.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for two-factor authentication setup
totp.backupHint: Each code works once. They won't be shown again.
totp.disableDescription: Confirm your password to turn off 2FA for your account.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: For programmatic access. The full key is shown once, when it is created.
apiKeys.scopeHint: The scope decides what the key can read or change. Read: everything a member can see. Write: read, plus creating, editing and deleting campaigns, offers, content and more — team and security settings excluded. Admin: everything, team and security included.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.revealDescription: This is the only time it is shown in full. If you lose it, revoke the key and create a new one.
apiKeys.usageAfter: on any API request — it signs in the same way your session does, within the key's scope.
apiKeys.revokeDescription: Anything using this key stops working immediately.

errors.name: Name must be at least 2 characters

apiKeys.rotateDescription: A new key with the same name and scope is created and shown once. The current key keeps working for 24 hours, then stops — switch your integrations to the new key before then.

integrations.adPlatformDescription: Imports ad spend automatically, for profit and ROI. Connected per traffic source.
integrations.noSources: Not set up on any traffic source yet

providers.namecheap: Domain registrar: renewals and DNS records for your domains.
providers.cloudflare: DNS records for your tracking domains.
providers.slack: Alerts set up under Settings → Alerts go to a channel through an incoming webhook.

integrations.connectDescription: Credentials are stored encrypted and never shown again after saving.
integrations.disconnectDescription: The stored credential is deleted. You can reconnect at any time.

telegram.title: Telegram bots
telegram.description: Your own bots: opening one from an ad records TG_START on the visit, joining one of its channels records TG_JOIN (once per click).
telegram.notConfigured: Not available on this deployment: TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL is not set.
telegram.noChannel: No channels: only TG_START is recorded
telegram.deepLinkHint: Use the bot link as an offer or destination URL: {click_id} opens the bot with the visit’s own click.
telegram.connectDescription: FLOX takes over the bot’s webhook: use a bot that does nothing else.
telegram.tokenHint: From @BotFather. Stored encrypted; it never leaves the server.
telegram.channelHint: @channelname or the channel id. Make the bot an admin with the right to invite users first.
telegram.welcomeHint: Sent when someone starts the bot, with a button to each channel.
telegram.removeDescription: Its webhook is removed: the bot stops answering and no more TG_START / TG_JOIN are recorded. Events already recorded stay.

errors.channelTaken: This channel is already added to the bot

telegram.copyClickInviteLink: Copy the channel link per click
telegram.inviteLinksEmpty: invite links ready — clicks get the shared channel link until the pool is refilled (about a minute)
telegram.clickInviteLinkHint: Or send visitors straight to the channel: the channel link per click gives each click its own invite link, so a join records TG_JOIN on it without opening the bot.
telegram.channelsFull: A bot has at most 10 channels
telegram.removeChannelDescription: Joins of this channel stop being recorded and its channel link per click stops working. The channel itself and its members stay as they are in Telegram.
telegram.noWelcome: No welcome message: /start is answered with the channel links
telegram.changeTokenDescription: After /revoke in @BotFather: paste the bot's new token. Channels, links and the /start history stay. Another bot's token is refused — remove this bot and connect the other instead.
telegram.newTokenHint: From @BotFather → your bot → API Token. Stored encrypted, never shown again.
